chunks: And from him, from a man who bequeathed bequests to his relatives, and the inheritor attained puberty, so he said to the executor that he should isolate a piece of land of the measure of what his bequests can be taken out from, when the inheritors distribute, and not include this land in their distribution, or how should he deal with it? So he said: 'Yes, such is befitting.'

key_terms.وَصَايَا: Bequests or specific legacies left in a will

ai.seo_question: How should an executor handle specific bequests from an estate without affecting the heirs' shares?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the mechanism for satisfying specific bequests (wasaaya) by isolating a designated asset, such as land, to cover the debt before the remaining estate is divided among heirs. This ruling ensures that the testator's specific wishes are fulfilled without diminishing the heirs' shares through a general valuation of the entire estate, reflecting the Shia juristic principle of prioritizing the fulfillment of bequests as a debt owed to the beneficiaries.
